title: askellia benthamii
intro: Askellia benthamii, commonly known as Bentham's askellia, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is native to Australia and is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Askellia benthamii include soothing irritated skin, reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
